name: ihp_gps_lna_nmos
description: GPS-band (~1.1-1.6 GHz target) single-ended CMOS LNA, common-source input stage with inductive source degeneration (M1/L2), cascode (M2), inductive drain load (L1), gate LC match (R3/C1/C2/L3), diode-connected NMOS bias generator (M3/R1/R2). Taped out through IHP's open-source SG13G2 MPW shuttle.

source.project: IHP-GmbH open-source SG13G2 tapeout, April 2025 campaign (Testfield T586)
source.commit_or_ref: main (as of retrieval; repo has no tags at time of retrieval)
source.process: IHP SG13G2 130nm SiGe BiCMOS, RF-LDMOS device model 'sg13_lv_nmos'
source.format_as_retrieved: Xyce-flavoured flat SPICE, xschem-exported (schematic -> flattened netlist), includes ESD/bondpad structures and testbench sources

conversion.route: raw .spice -> strip padframe/ESD -> rename X-prefixed R/C instances to plain R/C element syntax (see notes) -> spice2genie.convert() -> AnalogGenie .cir/Port -> SPICE2GRAPH_compress.build_connection_matrix (upstream, execed read-only) -> Augmentation.dfs_all_paths (upstream, execed read-only) -> token sequence -> lna/topology.py screen -> lna/to_spice.py -> ngspice
conversion.tool: lna/data/external/_tools/convert_and_build.py + lna/data/external/_tools/spice2genie.py (adapted from the analoggenie-dataset-expansion worktree's dataset_expansion/spice2genie.py)
edits_from_source: Removed 12 devices: XX1-XX4 (bondpads) and XD1-XD8 (ESD protection diodes). These are process-level I/O protection structures, not part of the LNA signal path; AnalogGenie's own dataset circuits never include pads/ESD, so this matches existing corpus convention.

Renamed X-prefixed resistor/capacitor subcircuit calls (XR1-XR3, XC1-XC2) to plain SPICE R/C element syntax (R1-R3, C1-C2) so the generic converter's direct r/c/l dispatch picks them up instead of trying (and failing) to resolve them as undefined subcircuits ('rppd', 'cap_rfcmim' are PDK primitives with no local .subckt definition in this excerpt). Net connectivity (first two nodes on each line) is unchanged; only the element-name prefix changed.

Voltage sources (VDD, vin) and all simulator directives (.lib/.include/.option/.ac/.print/.GLOBAL) are dropped automatically by the converter, matching AnalogGenie's topology-only, value-free representation -- consistent with how the existing 41-circuit corpus omits bias networks (see lna/FINDINGS.md §4b).
M1-M3 (sg13_lv_nmos, 4-terminal D/G/S/B) needed no edits; the converter's 5-token model-kind heuristic already resolves 'sg13_lv_nmos' to nmos4 correctly.
L1-L3 needed no edits (already plain SPICE L element syntax in the source).

notes: This is one of two sibling circuits taped out from the same project (an NMOS/rfmos variant and an NPN/HBT variant sharing the same bias generator M3/R1/R2, gate-match R3/C1/C2/L3, and drain inductor L1) -- see lna/data/external/ihp-gps-lna-npn/ for the bipolar sibling. Both are independent, unrelated designs from IHP's open tapeout program; neither is derived from, nor references, the Kanchetla et al. TMTT 2022 paper this pipeline is blind-reproducing.
